elements.element: Vendor provides transition assistance on expiry or termination
elements.evidence: (v) at Customer's request, Kubient will provide reasonable transition assistance ... following the effective date of termination or expiration

elements.element: Transition assistance available for up to 6 months
elements.evidence: for up to six (6) months following the effective date of termination or expiration

elements.element: Return of Customer Data within 30 days of expiry/termination
elements.evidence: within thirty (30) days following termination or expiration, Kubient will return to Customer all Customer data in Kubient's possession or control

elements.element: Return in a standard machine-readable format
Deletion of Customer Data after return
elements.evidence: will thereafter delete such data from its systems
and certify such deletion to Customer in writing
for up to six (6) months following the effective date of termination or expiration
within thirty (30) days following termination or expiration, Kubient will return to Customer all Customer data

reasons: All preferred atomic elements are expressly present: 6-month assistance, then-current rates, 30-day return running from termination or expiration (not from a later request), standard machine-readable format, deletion after return, and written certification.

The 'at Customer's request' condition attaches only to transition assistance; the mandatory data return, deletion and certification obligations are unconditional, so the request condition does not swallow the data-return mechanic.
Minimality holds: two concise sub-clauses inserted into an existing termination list that lacked any exit/data-return mechanic; no untouched sentence rewritten and no new exception created.

Intent preserved: existing (i)-(iv) obligations (cessation of Services, licence revocation, Confidential Information return/destruction) remain effective; 'Customer', 'Services' and 'termination or expiration' introduce no undefined terms or contradictions, and the added 'or expiration' scope only benefits us.
